_scale: Every stance is a number from -2 to 2 on the same axis as the question. 2 = strongly agrees with the statement, -2 = strongly disagrees, 0 = mixed. null/absent = unknown.

issues.statement: Raise taxes on the wealthy and big corporations.
issues.help: Think income tax rates for top earners, corporate tax rates, and tax cuts like the 2025 federal tax law.

issues.statement: Government should do more to make health care affordable.
issues.help: Expanding Medicaid, ACA subsidies or Medicare for All, versus market-based reforms and spending cuts.

Universal background checks, red flag laws, safe storage, assault-weapon limits.
More ICE funding, border wall, ending sanctuary cities, versus a path to citizenship and limits on ICE.

issues.statement: Fighting climate change should be a top priority, even if energy costs more.
issues.help: Clean-energy mandates and EV policy versus fewer regulations on fossil fuels.

issues.statement: Make it easier for workers to join unions.
issues.help: Repealing right-to-work, the PRO Act, protecting collective bargaining.

issues.statement: Require proof of citizenship and photo ID to vote.
issues.help: Voter ID and the SAVE Act versus easier early, absentee and automatic voting.

issues.statement: Expand legal protections for LGBTQ people.
issues.help: Anti-discrimination laws, same-sex marriage, transgender health care and sports rules.

issues.statement: Public money should help families pay for private school.
